column3: User creates a first task with a title, multi-line description and due date
column4:
1. Launch the app with cargo run
2. Press +
3. Type Buy milk
4. Press Tab, type Full cream, press Alt+Enter, type 2 litres
5. Press Tab, then type today's date as YYYY-MM-DD
6. Press Enter
7. Look at the Task panel
column5:
1. The List panel is empty and the Task panel says 'No task selected'
2. A popup titled 'New Task' opens with the fields 'Title:', 'Description:' and 'Due Date (YYYY-MM-DD):', the 'Title:' line is yellow, and the hint line reads 'Tab: Switch | Enter: Save | Alt+Enter: New line | Ctrl+U/D or PgUp/Dn: Scroll desc | Esc: Cancel'
3. The text appears after 'Title: '
4. The description field turns yellow and shows Full cream and 2 litres on two separate lines
5. The date field turns yellow and shows the date as typed
6. The popup closes and the List shows '>> 1. Buy milk (Due: <today>)' in yellow
7. The Task panel shows 'Title: Buy milk', 'Description:' followed by Full cream and 2 litres on separate lines, 'Due Date: <today>', 'Created:' with the current date and time, and 'Status: ○ Pending' in yellow

column3: User fumbles the due date, then fixes it
column4:
1. Launch the app with cargo run
2. Press +, type Dentist, press Tab twice to reach the date field
3. Type abc
4. Type 2099-13-45 and press Enter
5. Press Enter on Dentist to edit it, press Tab twice, press Backspace until the date field is empty, type 2099-06-15
6. Press Tab to go back to the Title field, then press Enter
7. Look at the List and the Task panel
column5:
3. Nothing appears in the date field: letters are not accepted
4. The popup closes, the List shows '1. Dentist' with no due date and the Task panel shows 'Due Date: Not set'
5. A popup titled 'Edit Task' opens with 'Title: Dentist', and the date field shows 2099-06-15
6. The popup closes
7. The List shows '1. Dentist (Due: 2099-06-15)' and the Task panel shows 'Due Date: 2099-06-15'

column3: User adds tasks in mixed order and finds them sorted by due date with colour cues
column4:
1. Launch the app with cargo run
2. Create these tasks in order with + (Tab twice to reach the date field): No date A (no date), Later (2099-12-31), Sooner (2099-01-01), No date B (no date), Old (2020-01-01), Today (today's date)
3. Look at the List
4. Press Up while 1. Old is selected
5. Press Down
6. Press Down three times
column5:
2. After each save the newly created task is the selected row (marked >>)
3. The List reads in this order: '1. Old (Due: 2020-01-01)' in red, '2. Today (Due: <today>)' in yellow, '3. Sooner (Due: 2099-01-01)', '4. Later (Due: 2099-12-31)', '5. No date A', '6. No date B', with 3 to 6 in the default colour
4. Selection wraps to '6. No date B' and the Task panel shows 'Title: No date B'
5. Selection wraps back to '1. Old' and the Task panel shows 'Title: Old' and 'Due Date: 2020-01-01'
6. Selection is on '4. Later' and the Task panel follows it, showing 'Title: Later'

column3: User edits a task, sees it re-sort, then abandons a second edit
column4:
1. Launch the app with cargo run. Create Alpha (due 2099-01-01) and Beta (due 2099-02-01)
2. Select '1. Alpha' and press Enter
3. Change the title to Alpha edited (Backspace and type), press Tab and type a description, press Tab and change the date to 2099-03-01, press Enter
4. Look at the List and the Task panel
5. Press Enter, change the title to Discard me, then press Esc
6. Quit with q and launch the app again
column5:
2. A popup titled 'Edit Task' opens with 'Title: Alpha' and 'Due Date (YYYY-MM-DD): 2099-01-01' already filled in
3. The popup closes
4. The List reads '1. Beta (Due: 2099-02-01)' then '2. Alpha edited (Due: 2099-03-01)', the selection (>>) is on Alpha edited, and the Task panel shows the new title, description and 'Due Date: 2099-03-01'
5. The popup closes and the task still reads Alpha edited
6. The List still reads Beta then Alpha edited with the edited description and date

column3: User writes a long description, scrolls it while editing and while reading
column4:
1. Launch the app with cargo run
2. Press +, type Long notes, press Tab, then type Line 1 to Line 20, pressing Alt+Enter between each
3. Press PageUp twice, then PageDown twice
4. Press Ctrl+U, then Ctrl+D
5. Press Enter to save
6. Press Tab twice to focus the Task panel, then press Down five times
7. Press Up five times
8. Create a second task Short, press Tab until the List is focused, press Up then Down to go back to Long notes

column4:

2. Select '1. First' and press d
3. Press Tab, then press Enter
4. Press d, then press Esc
5. Press d, press Right then Left, then press Enter
6. Quit with q and launch the app again
column5:

column3: User completes and deletes tasks, adds another, and finds every task kept on disk
column4:
1. Launch the app with cargo run. Create Done one, Deleted one and Active one (no dates)
2. Complete Done one with d and Enter; delete Deleted one with - and Enter
3. Press q, then run cat ~/.local/share/tdui/todos.json
4. Launch the app again
5. Press + and create New one, then press q
6. Run cat ~/.local/share/tdui/todos.json again
7. Launch the app and press Shift+Right to open Stats
column5:

4. Only Active one is listed
5. The List reads '1. Active one' then '2. New one'
6. The file still holds all four tasks, including Done one (completed true) and Deleted one (deleted true), and every task has a different id
7. 'Done' shows 1, 'Deleted' shows 1 and 'ToDo' shows 2
